name: Can moisture-resistant drywall prevent mold and mildew?
description: It helps inhibit mold and mildew growth by resisting moisture, but it doesn't entirely prevent it if persistent moisture issues or poor ventilation are present.

mainEntity.name: Can moisture-resistant drywall prevent mold and mildew?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moisture-resistant drywall is designed to inhibit the growth of mold and mildew, but it cannot entirely prevent it. Its treated core and water-repellent paper facing make it less hospitable for mold spores to grow compared to standard drywall when exposed to moisture. However, if there's a persistent leak, high humidity without proper ventilation, or continuous water saturation, mold can still develop. It acts as a preventive measure, but effective mold prevention also relies on addressing the source of moisture and ensuring adequate ventilation.
